title: Change event streaming in SQL database in Fabric (Preview)

content.text: Change event streaming (CES) captures row-level DML changes (inserts, updates, and deletes) in SQL database in Fabric and publishes each change to Fabric Eventstream or Azure Event Hubs in near real time as a CloudEvent, enabling downstream analytics and event-driven architectures with no ETL. For more information, see Change event streaming overview.
